title: GTS French Terry Cotton 5 Inch Shorts
typePath: GTS French Terry Cotton 5 Inch Shorts
description:
Model Specs: Drew Is 6’0”, 207lbs And Wearing A Size Large (GTS French Terry Cotton 5 Inch Shorts) 
 Soft French Terry Cotton Blend: Lightweight, Breathable, And Broken-In From The First Wear 
 5 Inch Inseam: An Above-The-Knee Length For A Clean, Modern Fit 
 Dual Side Zipper Pockets: Secure Storage For Your Phone, Keys, And Essentials That Won’t Fall Out 
 Rear Back Pocket For Extra Storage On The Go 
 Adjustable Drawstring Waistband For A Custom, Secure Fit 
 Custom TLF Metal Drawcord Caps With Icon Logo For A Premium Finish 
 Utilizes Infi-Stretch™, Infi-Soft™, Infi-Defense™, And Sweat-Wicking Technologies 
 Tonal Embroidery Icon Logo On Left Leg Hem 
 Designed For: Lifestyle, Travel + All-Day Wear 
 Fabric: French Terry Cotton (94% Cotton, 6% Spandex) 
 Fit: Relaxed  
 Colors: Black, Cream, Quiet Shade 
 The GTS French Terry Cotton 5 Inch Shorts bring everyday comfort with a clean look that works anywhere you’re headed. Made from a soft French terry cotton blend, these men’s cotton shorts feel broken-in from the first wear, with a relaxed fit that never restricts movement. The 5-inch inseam hits above the knee for a sharp, modern length, while an adjustable drawstring waistband with custom TLF metal drawcord caps dials in your fit. Dual side zipper pockets keep your phone and keys secure, so nothing falls out, and a rear back pocket adds extra storage. Wear these men’s 5-inch shorts on travel days, recovery, or the weekend. They’re the terry cloth shorts you’ll reach for
